original_test_intent: Validate management-I2C/SMBus sideband connectivity for the M.2 board represented by code 00452 and correlate expected sideband devices with the correct physical M.2 slots and NVMe inventory without affecting storage.
original_method: The storage/platform owner maps this code to board revision, slots and NVMe devices, supplies the BMC controller/mux/address path, approves identity/sensor/status reads and expected values, then the agent collects sideband plus pre/post NVMe health evidence.
manual_activity: The storage/platform owner maps code 00452 to the M.2 board, populated slots and NVMe serials, differentiates row 1809 coverage, approves sideband reads and recovery, and declares any separate physical stage.
required_inputs: BMC/OOB controller, mux and sideband route
Expected sideband device addresses and identities

Differentiate or de-duplicate row-1809 project coverage
Approve sideband targets/registers and expected values

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command is supplied, which is safer than guessing. The physical-continuity interpretation is unsupported; conditional logical collection becomes valid only after slot-to-sideband and slot-to-NVMe identities are correlated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through the approved BMC/OOB route, read only mapped M2_BD identity/sensor/status targets and correlate each response with the expected slot and NVMe serial while preserving complete storage health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: M2_BD, code 00452, TBD fields and two-minute estimates are preserved; no board, slot, NVMe, bus, address, register or temperature is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES CODE-00452 M2 SIDEBAND PACKAGE AND CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Fingerprint board, slots and NVMe devices; capture baseline namespaces/SMART/kernel state; traverse the documented BMC mux route; read only approved sideband identity/sensor/status fields; verify response-to-slot mapping and unchanged NVMe, BMC and thermal health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines conditional management-sideband coverage without inventing a physical continuity test or replacing TBD.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Sideband responses prove only the mapped management path. NVMe enumeration alone does not prove that path, and neither establishes connector mechanics or electrical continuity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: M.2 sideband devices may share EEPROM, sensors and power/reset controls; a wrong target can reset or remove live storage.

project_override_considerations: The project must explicitly distinguish this code from row 1809 or record one as non-applicable/duplicate for that project. The Master remains unchanged and a single evidence set cannot silently satisfy both atomic records.
expected_evidence: Before/after NVMe SMART/health, namespaces, kernel events, BMC SEL/SDR and temperature

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: This row is incomplete rather than contradictory. Related M2_BD coverage under another code requires project applicability separation, but atomic identities can remain distinct without assuming a Master conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A storage-safe passive sideband read and evidence boundary are definable. Board/slot/device mapping, route and expected responses are project inputs; once supplied, a deterministic plan exists under ED-04.

review_improvement: Rejects an unsupported manual-only method, makes M.2 sideband-to-NVMe slot correlation central, forbids storage-affecting control access and prevents double counting the earlier M2_BD row.
independent_technical_reasoning: The I2C sideband and NVMe PCIe data path are independent enough that either can appear healthy while the other is misrouted. Meaningful evidence must bind the sideband responder to a physical slot and stable NVMe serial, then prove namespaces and health were unaffected. That can be automated with an approved map and read allowlist; generic scans or physical assumptions cannot.
